description: Get the full audience targeting configuration for an ad group. Use after nevent_list_paid_ad_groups to get a valid adGroupId. Returns: ageRange, genders, geoSummary (countries/cities/regions), topInterests, topBehaviors, placements, Advantage+ flags (automaticPlacements, expandAge, expandGender), custom and excluded audiences, bidStrategy, promotedObject. A 404 may mean this tenant is not enrolled in the insights pilot — call nevent_paid_ads_health to confirm.

adGroupId.description: Ad group (ad set) ID from the provider. Use nevent_list_paid_ad_groups to get valid adGroupId values.

name: nevent_get_paid_ad_group_targeting
